title: Validate Real Craig Multitrack Call Evidence
objective: Validate one real nine-track Craig package and produce an 18-sample local-only per-track ASR canary before any full transcription or candidate integration.
moduleGoal: Measure real Craig source metadata, track association, audio timing and bounded track-attributed ASR utility without semantic promotion.
observableOutcome: A reusable bounded-header intake, nine normalized local tracks, deterministic 18-clip human-validation packet and compact privacy-safe readiness artifacts.
metricContribution: Nine-track validity, codec/rate/channel/duration and timeline spreads, 18-sample distribution, runtime, overlap and privacy counts.
remainingModuleGap: ASR semantic quality remains pending human classification; candidate, VOD and replay time axes remain absent.
hardeningDeferred: No full-recording ASR, hotwords, medium/large models, diarization, VOD/replay sync, candidate linkage, strategy or Task 209.

executionContract.reasoningComplexity: High: real private multitrack media, bounded binary-header parsing, timeline preservation, deterministic sampling and strict versioned privacy.
executionContract.objective: Deliver the smallest real Craig multitrack intake and human-quality canary.
technicalContext: Task 207 is Work-accepted at the exact base.
The user explicitly authorized the observed local package path .local/deadem/craig/scrim_2026-09-01 after the requested inbox path was absent.
confirmedState: The package structurally contains nine AAC files, info.txt and raw.dat.
The raw.dat header is JSON followed by binary Ogg/Opus payload and must be read only to the top-level closing brace.
branchEnvironment: Create and publish exactly one Task 208 commit.
allowedScope: Read only the explicitly authorized Craig package and existing Task 205 adapter/ASR implementation.
Write local private normalized audio, clips, identity metadata and transcripts below .local/deadem/craig/recordings.
protectedAreas: Never access any replay, VOD, replay_005 through replay_008 or parser package.
Never version audio, filenames with identity, Discord identifiers, names or transcript/word text.
expectedChanges: Reusable intake/metadata/probe/canary tools, generalized local ASR helper, real adapter representation, focused tests, compact artifacts and coordination/report files.
acceptanceCriteria: Nine ordinal tracks map without ambiguity and all AACs decode/probe.
Exactly 18 deterministic temporally distributed local clips receive comparable small CPU int8 ASR.
Compact outputs disclose timing/overlap/config metrics but no identity, filenames, paths or transcript text.
mandatoryTests: Focused bounded header, intake, probe, adapter, overlap, selection and privacy tests.
Real pipeline canary, lint, coordination/task/output validators and codex validation.
requiredEvidence: Five compact versioned JSONs, private validation sheet/metadata, test logs and post-commit attestation.
commitPolicy: One commit named Validate real Craig multitrack call evidence.
Explicit staging and normal push to origin/main.
stopConditions: Stop on invalid input, ambiguous track mapping, privacy leak, protected access, full-ASR attempt or non-small model.
returnReportFormat: Resultado, O que passou a funcionar, Valor observável, Impacto no módulo, Limitação relevante, Próximo objetivo and Previsão operacional.

stopConditions: Do not read replay/VOD inputs or protected aliases.
Do not version real identity, filenames, paths, transcripts, words or media.
Do not run full nine-track ASR or create Task 209.
